revision_reason: R02 verified that 50 MHz remains low pressure and that horizon aggregation alone cannot support the next branch decision. R03 adds receipt-bound one-second directed-ISL and matched queue-wait diagnostics, freezes a four-way adaptive decision tree, and narrows execution to 5 MHz versus 2 MHz instead of expanding the matrix contract or duplicating a deterministic 2 MHz cell.
objective: Execute one reviewed 5 MHz versus 2 MHz fixed-scenario bracket and classify the 2 MHz arm using preregistered one-second directed-ISL utilization, same-link queue waiting, physical-validity and drain-validity evidence.
context: R02 formally verified 500 MHz and 50 MHz at maximum horizon-aggregate directed-ISL utilization 0.005871255030063291 and 0.020761875237929505 with identical served bits, packet fate, zero-rate holds and natural drain; 50 MHz is not pressure.

The existing matrix v1 contract permits exactly two cells per pairing key. R03 therefore uses a preregistered adaptive bracket: 5 MHz versus 2 MHz now, and 2 MHz versus 1 MHz only in R04 if R03 is physically valid, fully drained and still below pressure.
The pressure decision is frozen in pressure-decision.json before execution. It has four outcomes: PHYS_INVALID, DRAIN_INCOMPLETE, PRESSURE_CANDIDATE and NO_PRESSURE_PHYS_VALID.

The new window analyzer rebins raw link_service_windows and link_available_windows by exact interval overlap. It reports numerator and denominator separately and rejects overlapping service, service without availability and malformed time evidence.

queue_area_bits_s remains a five-category horizon integral and is not misrepresented as per-link or per-window evidence. Same-link queue waiting is reconstructed only from exact queue_enter to service_start identities; unmatched entries are censored and separately reported.
This remains a one-seed engineering calibration. A pressure candidate must later be confirmed with preregistered adjacent seeds before a paper-facing statement or algorithm comparison.
excluded_inputs: Any result observed before pressure-decision.json is frozen
Any dynamically edited or locally launched formal simulation config
Any simultaneous bandwidth and traffic change
Any RL training or large matrix
deliverables: A tested one-second directed-ISL window diagnostic integrated into the evidence-bound V2 analysis
A structured four-way pressure decision frozen before execution
A compiled two-cell 5 MHz versus 2 MHz matrix with serial fail-closed execution
Three independent exact-revision reviews and an accepted finalization before authorization
Two receipt-verified VM outputs and a persisted V2 analysis if all gates pass
cannot_claim: Algorithm superiority or a causal information-value effect
A 1 MHz result when R04 was not executed
Paper-ready statistical evidence from one seed
Q0 optimality or a new algorithm contribution
Congestion when physical validity or drain validity fails
acceptance: The exact R03 analyzer, tests, decision contract, request and compiled artifacts pass independent cold-start, satellite-DRL and adversarial review with no unresolved blocker.

Synthetic tests prove that a two-second saturated burst remains visible when its horizon aggregate is low, interval boundaries are apportioned exactly, service without availability fails, overlapping directed-link service fails and unmatched queue entries are not imputed.
The two cells share actual trace, seed, deterministic routing, topology, access, demand, emission, observation and drain contracts; the only declared intervention is links.rf_isl.bandwidth_hz.
The b2 cell is not launched until the b5 predecessor passes natural-end, conservation, receipt, governance, external-witness, identity, ISL-metric and zero-rate gates.

The final classification follows pressure-decision.json in declared order and reports served bits, available capacity, available time, utilization, same-link matched queue wait, censored queue entries, fate and access diagnostics without post-hoc threshold changes.
PHYS_INVALID or DRAIN_INCOMPLETE stops this bracket and blocks algorithm comparison; PRESSURE_CANDIDATE stops before 1 MHz; only NO_PRESSURE_PHYS_VALID permits a separately preregistered R04.
